context: Tests whether the agent follows a contract-first workflow when extending an existing API: the OpenAPI 3.1 spec is updated to define the new endpoint, and the implementation matches that spec exactly in terms of path, method, and response structure. A CHANGES.md log is used to inspect the agent's workflow reasoning.

checklist.name: New path in spec
checklist.description: openapi.yaml defines at least one new path beyond /upload (e.g. /files or similar listing route)

checklist.name: GET method in spec
checklist.description: The new path in openapi.yaml uses the GET HTTP method

checklist.name: 200 response schema defined
checklist.description: The new path's 200 response in openapi.yaml includes a content block with a schema (array or object containing file metadata)

checklist.name: Security requirement in spec
checklist.description: The new path in openapi.yaml includes a security requirement entry (e.g. bearerAuth)

checklist.name: OpenAPI 3.1 version preserved
checklist.description: The output openapi.yaml retains the openapi version string "3.1.0" (not downgraded to 3.0.x or omitted)

checklist.name: Matching route in server.js
checklist.description: server.js registers a route at the exact same path declared in openapi.yaml for the new endpoint (e.g. app.get('/files', ...))

checklist.name: Matching HTTP method in server.js
checklist.description: The HTTP method used for the new route in server.js matches the method declared in openapi.yaml (both GET)

checklist.name: JSON array response in server.js
checklist.description: The new route in server.js responds with res.json(...) returning an array or object containing file records (consistent with openapi.yaml schema)

checklist.name: CHANGES.md exists
checklist.description: CHANGES.md is present in the working directory

checklist.name: CHANGES.md references spec update
checklist.description: CHANGES.md mentions updating openapi.yaml (or the OpenAPI spec / API spec) as one of the steps taken

checklist.name: Spec-first order in CHANGES.md
checklist.description: CHANGES.md describes updating openapi.yaml before (or as the first step of) updating server.js — not implementation-first
